summary: Equinor says its cyberattack has been stopped, and production was not hurt. The NSA's classified network is still partly down, and officials blame software patching, not an attack. US stock futures are lower after Thursday's 2% drop. Bitcoin is near 62K, down about 10% on the week.

events.title: Equinor says its cyberattack has been stopped
events.impact: Production ran as normal. Equinor sees no sign that data was stolen or changed. Internal email was reported down earlier. Norwegian utility Skagerak Energi also reported an attempted cyberattack this week.
events.stated_cause: Equinor calls it a cyberattack, not a virus, and says it did not seem aimed at Equinor alone. Nobody has said who did it.

events.title: NSA classified network still partly down
events.impact: Some staff were told to work from home for a third day. A Georgia site that supports Middle East intelligence work was also hit. Officials say mission-critical systems still work.
events.stated_cause: The Director of National Intelligence says patching of PHP software flaws left some systems not coming back up. The NSA said routine maintenance. No official source reports a cyberattack.

events.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard say outside providers were hacked
events.impact: JPMorgan says attackers got marketing data held by vendors, maybe names and emails. Press reports say about 16,000 records leaked. Payments were not disrupted.
events.stated_cause: Hackers hit outside vendors. A ransomware group reportedly leaked data. JPMorgan says this has no link to Monday's outage.

events.title: US stocks fell about 2% Thursday; futures lower Friday
events.impact: Dow fell 1,101 points to 49,097 and the Nasdaq fell 2.25% to 23,879 on Thursday. Friday premarket, Nasdaq 100 futures were down about 1.5%. The US market has not opened yet today. I saw no trading halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports point to AI-stock worries around the Anthropic IPO and Nvidia weakness. No technical or attack cause reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 62K USD, down about 10% on the week
events.impact: Coinbase shows about 61,957, down 2.7% on the day. CoinGecko shows about 61,862, down 2.2% in 24h and 10.8% in 7 days. It is a steady slide, not a crash. I found no exchange outage.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Earlier reports cited rate worries and fund outflows.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: The status feed (updated 11:16 UTC) lists Cloudflare Sites and Services as degraded, changed 04:35 UTC today. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Officials say recent outages are unrelated and not malicious
events.impact: Homeland Security's secretary said he is 98% sure it is not a cyberattack. This is an official view, not a proven finding.
events.stated_cause: Officials point to patching, router work and software bugs. They name no attacker.

events.title: PlayStation Network outage resolved
events.impact: Sony confirmed problems with games and network features on Wednesday. By Thursday morning services looked normal again.
events.stated_cause: Sony has not given a cause in what I read.

connection_assessment.reasoning: Equinor says it was hit by a cyberattack that is now stopped, and nobody has named who did it. The NSA outage is blamed on software patching by the intelligence director. JPMorgan says its vendor hack is not linked to its outage. No official source links these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No confirmed sign of a shared cause or a widespread failure in the last few hours.

prep_note: Keep normal habits. Watch your bank and card accounts for odd activity. Be careful with emails that mention these breaches, since scammers use them. Keep some cash on hand and update your software as usual. Check back for official updates on the NSA outage.
